# quip

> > Award-winning oral wellness brand offering innovative electric toothbrushes, water flossers, and refill subscriptions designed to make dental care simple and accessible.

Quip is a direct-to-consumer oral care company specializing in sonic and oscillating electric toothbrushes with smart features, subscription-based refill models, and a curated product ecosystem. The brand emphasizes simplicity, affordability, and habit-building through app-integrated smart toothbrushes and convenient automatic refill plans.

## Key Topics

- Electric Toothbrush
- Sonic Technology
- Oscillating Toothbrush
- Smart Toothbrush
- Subscription Refills
- Brush Head Refills
- Water Flosser
- Ultra Lite Sonic
- Rev Oscillating
- EasyClick Brush Pod
- Dental Care
- Oral Wellness
- App Tracking
- Battery-Powered
- Rechargeable
